sample.workingCopies: 1280px JPEGs with neutral filenames and embedded source metadata removed
sample.submittedImages: 1200px maximum edge, JPEG quality 75, ten independent image inputs per request

finalRun.responseMode: json_object with local Photo-Select validation; server-side JSON Schema not claimed

pricing.formula: ((promptTokens - cachedTokens) * inputCacheMiss + cachedTokens * inputCacheHit + completionTokens * output) / 1000000
pricing.note: Image tokens are included in prompt tokens; reasoning tokens are included in completion tokens. Neither breakdown is added twice. All three attempts, including the invalid reply, are included.

visualReview.reviewer: independent assistant visual review; not Jamie approval
caveats: An exact closed-flower-bud count is wrong and omits a partially cropped additional bloom.
Bird orientation is overstated; bare branches and dried pods do not establish an off-season capture.
Exact midday and seasonal continuity are inferred from appearance.
The notebook changes an ambiguous description of the truck's state into an unreadable state/plate marking, adding an unsupported interpretation.

limitations: This tests a separate private compatibility harness using the shared image builder and reply validation, not a production Xiaomi CLI provider.
A single selected ten-photo group with a custom brief is not a representative or blind photographic-quality benchmark.
JSON parsing succeeded for all replies, but one reply needed a closing-question repair; this is not general contract reliability evidence.
The earlier HTTP 402 request returned no usage or cost; missing usage is unknown, not zero.
Comparative savings, human editorial agreement, hosted weights identity and general reliability remain unmeasured.
